0022600174.text: The Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, 7th in the East) visit the Washington Wizards (4-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East), with Atlanta on a one-game winning streak and 3-2 on the road, while Washington is on a two-game winning streak and 2-1 at home. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle, 18.3 points and 32.6 minutes per game this season), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have no games yet this season, the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 126-96 Atlanta win on February 26, 2026, in Atlanta.
